stage: Step 7 -- delete the bucket while it still contains a retained object

response.message: The bucket you tried to delete is not empty.

note: The recursive delete first attempted to remove the contained object, which independently returned the 403/retentionPolicyNotMet result recorded in 03-delete-retained-object-403.json; the bucket-delete call itself then returned this 409. The JSON API surface returns the generic 'conflict' reason here, not a distinct BucketNotEmpty-style reason (that specific reason string exists only on the XML API surface per prior documentation research) -- this is the empirical resolution of that documentation gap. Headers and client identity fields removed.
